en: You know PROF. OAK, right?\pHis order came in.\nCan I get you to take it to him?
{PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL\nfrom the POKéMON MART clerk.
Okay, thanks! Please say hi to\nPROF. OAK for me, too.
This shop does good business in\nANTIDOTES, I've heard.
I've got to buy some POTIONS.\pYou never know when your POKéMON\nwill need quick healing.
